whatIsAI.title: AI Wakayyan Kya Hai?
whatIsAI.definition: Mausnoee Zehani koi jadoo ya sochne wala makhluq nahi hai. Yeh ek takatwar tool hai jo bade andaze mein data mein namoona talash karta hai.
whatIsAI.analogyText: AI ko sikhana bacche ko sikhane jesa hai ke 'kutta' kya hai. Aap unhe Biology ki kitaab nahi dete. Aap unhe hazaron kutto ki tasweerein dikhate ho jab tak un ka dimagh fatahari taur par namoona ko na samajh le!
whatIsAI.point1: AI misaalon se seekhta hai, pehle se likhe hue ausul se nahi
whatIsAI.point2: Yeh aese namoone talash karta hai jo insaan chhod sakte hain
whatIsAI.point3: Sifarishen, Aavaaz Ke Yaar Aur Nakshon Mein Rozmarrah Istemal
